title: Portfolio

test.method: Direct CUA replay in the Rust-backed local integration browser
test.helper: Direct UI checks; tests/portfolio-ui.mjs gained a Local Paper fills-empty-state assertion and passed node --check, but the helper was not executed.
test.route: Accounts → Open portfolio in the existing disposable workspace; verified 1280x900, 768x900, and 390x844, then restored the browser's default viewport.

assertions.simulationDisclosure: TRADEX_SIMULATION · LOCAL_PAPER; Local Paper is TradeX simulation; its balances and results are not provider truth or Live execution.
assertions.currencySourceMessage: No saved currency-rate source is selected. Configure a source in Settings if an external rate is required.
assertions.fillsEmptyState: No fills in the Local Paper simulation.

commandLog.note: The large data.fx.requirements/data.fx.connection counts are the documented 1-second local projection/expiry polls; they did not call an external source. No data.fx.refresh, provider action, Gateway, order, or financial write ran.

limitations: Only the single built-in Local Paper account was present. No mixed-currency cross-account holdings or external provider account was read; the USD-to-USD identity route does not verify external FX or stablecoin data use.
No saved currency-rate source was selected and no external rate refresh occurred. Per user direction, S29.11 data-use basis remains skipped because no basis was provided.
The USD 100000 equity/cash and zero P&L/exposure are Local Paper simulation state, not provider truth or live portfolio performance.
External HTTP, browser console warnings/errors, and page errors were not instrumented in this direct CUA replay.
Native VoiceOver and broader S09/S33 acceptance remain open; E3 stays IMPLEMENTED_UNVERIFIED.
